name: Kie
source:
A total otaku whose main goal in life is to make others laugh. Loves visual novels.

Kie gave up on his performance arts degree to follow the steps of a writer that he calls his hero. He wants to create something that can change someone's life for the better.

Energetic, chaotic and fun, he's like a little brother to the rest of the gang. Or a gremlin.

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/doce-fim]official profile[/url]]
